notes: Incidence of crime under different heads in the States, Union Territories and important Cities during 1970 and 1971 and the percentage change

Table 5 presents statistics of crime during 1970 and 1971 under the important heads of I.P.C. crime along with the percentage variations during 1971 over 1970 in the States, Union Territories and important Cities. The detailed break-up of these statistics like cases reported and their disposal are shown in Appendices 1-13.

Crime in different districts of all the States and cities having a population of one lakh and above under important heads are presented in Appendices 14 and 15. The population and area in different districts of India and the population of cities are furnished in Appendices 86 and 87.
